messages:
Liam (AM): opening StormGate POC thread. Customer needs Private deployment in their AWS account, single stable egress IP for firewall allowlist, and completion of security questionnaire. POC window: 10 business days.
Rae (SE): key asks: preserve client source IP for downstream auditing and ensure control-plane comms are TLS+mTLS option. Also they want recommendation PrivateLink vs Peering.
Omar (NetOps): recommendation: PrivateLink for cross-account simplicity and stable DNS. VPC Peering works only if no overlapping CIDRs and adds route table maintenance. For stable egress IPs -> NAT Gateway(s) with EIPs per AZ OR NLBs with EIPs and proxy-protocol v2 to preserve source IP.
Zoe (InfoSec): questionnaire blockers: rotating egress IPs and TLS inspection. Draft attestation language: "No public inbound ports required. Outbound HTTPS (TCP/443) only to control-plane FQDNs (*.redwood-inference.com) and model artifact endpoints (s3.amazonaws.com or model-registry.redwood-inference.com). TLS 1.2+ enforced; mTLS available for Private deployments. Customers may provide dedicated EIP(s) for allowlisting. Customer-managed KMS (CMK) is supported and KMS calls are logged in CloudTrail."
Rae (SE): quick test customers can run for PrivateLink: `curl -v https://vpce-0aa1bb2c.vpce-svc-zzz.us-west-2.vpce.amazonaws.com/health -H 'Host: api.redwood-inference.com'`
Omar (NetOps): firewall snippet to paste: allow outbound TCP/443 to `*.redwood-inference.com` and `s3.amazonaws.com`; if using Private DNS allow UDP/TCP/53 to VPC resolver. If they need IPs, have them allocate NAT EIPs and share them.
Zoe (InfoSec): TLS-inspect caveat: if corporate proxies rewrite SNI/certs, suggest bypass for our FQDNs or enable mTLS to prevent MITM. Add to questionnaire.
Liam (AM): action items: 1) Rae -> one-page network diagram + curl test (ETA today). 2) Omar -> firewall rules + NAT/EIP pattern + ballpark NAT cost (ETA EOD). 3) Zoe -> final attestation wording + cert links (ETA tomorrow). 4) Sales -> include two POC pricing patterns in quote (reuse NAT vs dedicated NAT+EIPs).
infra-bot: POC sandbox provisioned in us-west-2 (build-2247). :rocket:
Liam (AM): thanks team, will present options to StormGate tomorrow. Add any one-line clarifications here.
Rae (SE): one-liner for questionnaire: "Control-plane traffic uses TLS 1.2+ to public FQDNs; customers can guarantee egress with dedicated EIPs for allowlisting."
Zoe (InfoSec): one-liner: "Private deployments support customer-managed CMKs; KMS usage auditable via CloudTrail."
